incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT -> P1 autoscaler-lag firing for service=inference-queue. queue_size=12000, target_processing_rate=600 rps, observed_processing_rate=240 rps. paging eng-oncall.

pagerduty: PagerDuty Incident #45 triggered: "autoscaler not scaling - queue backlog". Status: triggered (unacknowledged).

Priya S: acked. I'm on it. First pass: confirm scope. @Samir K @Jess R please monitor metrics and don't escalate yet unless customer-facing errors spike.

Samir K: looking at grafana -> /d/redwood/inference-queue?orgId=1
Prometheus query: `sum(rate(inference_requests_processed_total[1m])) by (pod)` shows processing ~240rps. `inference_queue_depth` = 11892.
I see node provisioning requests queued to cloud provider, but kube-autoscaler hasn't increased nodes in last 10m.

Jess R: digging into cluster autoscaler logs. Found repeated failed scale-up attempts:
```
I0310 03:10:12 scale_up.go:123] unable to scale up: insufficient quota for node type g5.xlarge
E0310 03:10:14 cloudprovider.go:88] Request failed: QUOTA_EXCEEDED
```
Looks like cloud quota is blocking. Opening a ticket with infra, but need immediate mitigation.

Mike T: manual mitigation: spinning up warm nodes in fallback pool and rerouting lower-priority tenants.
Command I'm running:
```
kubectl --context=prod apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: Node
metadata:
  labels:
    fallback: "true"
spec: {}
EOF
```
(placeholder to trigger provisioning with infra script)

Priya S: also enabling overflow routing: directing non-critical traffic to dedicated-fallback backend for 10m.
Route change:
`/api/v1/inference -> dedicated-fallback (weight 20%)`

Samir K: alerting SRE for cloud quota lift. @ops-runner can you confirm quota increase ETA?

ops-runner: cloud quota request submitted (#CQ-789). Provider estimate: 22-35 minutes for manual approval. We're pushing for expedited review.

Jess R: in the meantime I increased autoscaler tolerance and lowered cool-down to encourage smaller scale-ups:
```
apiVersion: autoscaling/v1
kind: AutoScaler
spec:
  scaleDownDelay: 30s
  scaleUpCooldown: 15s
```
Monitor: queue depth trending down to 6.2k over last 5m after manual nodes and overflow route.

Priya S: customer impact: elevated 5xxs for 2% of requests primarily for large-batch workloads. Notifying support to prepare for customer callbacks. Sending update to status page.

Mike T: manual nodes are provisioning (6/8 ready). Processing rate climbed to ~520rps. Queue at 4300.

Priya S: good. I'll stay until stable. If we hit queue>8k again, escalate to infra lead for emergency quota.

Samir K: preparing a short post-incident note: root cause appears to be cloud quota preventing autoscaler from provisioning. Mitigations: overflow routing, manual warm node spinup, lowered autoscaler cooldown. Followups: request permanent quota bump and autoscaler health checks.

Priya S: handing off to @Jess R for night watch. Jess, please post final metrics and assign follow-ups in #postmortems.

Jess R: ack. Taking over. Will post a summary in 30m with graphs.

pagerduty: PagerDuty Incident #45 acknowledged by Priya S. Status: acknowledged.
